verdict: Changes requested; no product edits until focused re-review
basis: R1 report git-ai-guide-review-pij-armed-cow.md and primary source inspected by Main

accepted.decision: Add an explicit absolute Git-executable input/injection seam and pass real standard Git through sealed positive proof; preserve missing-Git negative case and Git-AI-absent success proof.

Specify real parser/frontend routing, repository representation, registry fixture strategy and descriptor/capabilities. Preserve existing invocations and behavior. Additive flags are not inherently forbidden by ac-0002; the actual gap is missing concrete integration contract, not a ban on extending syntax.
Specify common profile/source attributes on every record plus the closing manifest field set and source-path meaning. No invented offsets/times/spans.

Retain syntactically valid unresolved attestation keys as source evidence with explicit identity resolution status; no speculative cross-note lookup. Specify non-commit target handling separately as an explicit unsupported case if commits-only scope is retained.
Clarify optionally quoted paths and legal single-line plus inclusive-range forms.
Own the narrow boot/check regression files and wire Git Notes into real readiness with an honest scope; do not claim a prose scope update is proof.

Avoid whole-tree enumeration for an explicit commit selection; retain bounded all-notes mode. State Unix runtime support honestly and give foreign-owned repository failures an actionable typed disposition rather than weakening safe.directory globally.

rejected.decision: Do not remove 7-character legacy-key support on this rationale. Git AI Standard v3.0.0 line193 explicitly says implementations SHOULD accept 7-character hashes for versions before v1.0. Parsing that documented note compatibility form does not depend on the private checkpoint cache. Keep compatibility source-labelled and tested independently.

known_refinements: Concrete GitObjectLoader name avoids trait collision.
Output exclusion covers canonical worktree root and Git common dir, not just nested input repo directory.
review_accuracy_note: Do not claim 16MiB input necessarily fits 32MiB serialized output: escaping/expansion may exceed it. The existing writer bound and explicit OutputLimit failure are the relevant guarantee.
instructions: Araminta owns guide/task/proof-map corrections via DD, then supplies new digests and focused disposition to the same independent reviewer. No repeating baseline boot or unrequested implementation while this design review remains open.
